paragraphs.text: Miron Tillas is a human from an unknown plane who traveled to Thunder Junction between 4562 and 4563 AR, where he has a bounty outstanding.

Miron Tillas Jr. is a renowned outlaw on Thunder Junction . A human with black hair and light brown skin, he stands out in his Freestriders attire. He wears sun-motif leather and hat and wields both a thundercaster and a throwing knife, characteristic of the Freestriders' adventurous spirit. Miron's strategic approach is to focus on opponents who are most vulnerable or positioned disadvantageously, a hallmark of his cunning and skill in the outlaw's world. His reputation as a high-profile criminal is cemented by his ability to execute daring crimes and evade capture, which has put a bounty on his back.
